baseline_output: No cierre la puerta trasera; la puerta delantera ya está cerrada.
reference: No cierres con llave la verja de atrás; la de adelante ya está cerrada con llave.
source: Don't lock the back gate; the front gate is already locked.

baseline_output: Ponga a un lado dieciséis centímetros, no sesenta, para el soporte.
reference: Reserva dieciséis centímetros para el soporte, no sesenta.
source: Set aside sixteen centimeters, not sixty, for the bracket.

baseline_output: El ensayo de Juniper se ha trasladado al viernes a las diez de la noche.
reference: El ensayo de Juniper se ha cambiado al viernes a las diez de la noche.
source: The Juniper rehearsal has moved to Friday at ten p.m.

baseline_output: Estoy a punto de ayudar, pero vamos a terminar un día después de la última entrega.
reference: Me apunto a ayudar, pero demos por terminado el día después de la última entrega.
source: I'm down to help, but let's call it a day after the last delivery.

baseline_output: Le dijiste que había llamado, pero sólo le envié un mensaje.
reference: Le dijiste que yo había llamado, pero solo le mandé un mensaje.
source: You told her I had called, but I only sent her a message.

baseline_output: Nuestra cabina está en el piso veintiuno, justo por encima del vigésimo.
reference: Nuestro puesto está en el vigésimo primer piso, justo encima del vigésimo.
source: Our booth is on the twenty-first floor, just above the twentieth.

baseline_output: Do not close the valve on the left; the valve on the right is already closed.
reference: Don't close the valve on the left; the one on the right is already closed.
source: No cierres la válvula de la izquierda; la de la derecha ya está cerrada.

baseline_output: There were fifteen milliliters per jar, not fifty.
reference: It was fifteen milliliters per bottle, not fifty.
source: Eran quince mililitros por frasco, no cincuenta.

baseline_output: Acacia's workshop is on Thursday at ten o'clock at night.
reference: The Acacia workshop is being moved to Thursday at ten p.m.
source: El taller de Acacia se pasa al jueves a las diez de la noche.

baseline_output: No wonder you left me in sight: you kept your cell phone in the car.
reference: No wonder you read my message without replying: you left your phone in the car.
source: Con razón me dejaste en visto: se te quedó el celular en el coche.

baseline_output: I asked you to let her know; I don't even have her number.
reference: I asked you to tell them yourself; I don't even have their number.
source: Te pedí que le avisaras tú; yo ni siquiera tengo su número.

baseline_output: I live on the seventeenth floor, but delivery is on the sixteen.
reference: I live on the seventeenth floor, but the delivery is to the sixteenth.
source: Vivo en el decimoséptimo piso, pero la entrega es en el dieciséis.

baseline_output: Do not cut the microphone on the right; the microphone on the left is already cut.
reference: Don't mute the microphone on the right; the one on the left is already muted.
source: Ne coupe pas le micro de droite ; celui de gauche est déjà coupé.

baseline_output: It takes one hundred and fifty grams of flour, not one hundred and fifteen.
reference: You need a hundred and fifty grams of flour, not a hundred and fifteen.
source: Il faut cent cinquante grammes de farine, pas cent quinze.

baseline_output: Bellevue's workshop is postponed until Monday at eight o'clock in the evening.
reference: The Bellevue workshop is postponed until Monday at eight p.m.
source: L'atelier de Bellevue est reporté à lundi, à huit heures du soir.

baseline_output: He put a rabbit on me, so I gave someone else his place.
reference: He stood me up, so I gave his spot to someone else.
source: Il m'a posé un lapin, alors j'ai donné sa place à quelqu'un d'autre.

baseline_output: You're the one who called him; all I did was write to him.
reference: You were the one who called him; I only wrote to him.
source: C'est toi qui l'as appelé ; moi, je n'ai fait que lui écrire.

baseline_output: Go first to the seventeenth floor, then go back down to the sixteenth.
reference: Go to the seventeenth floor first, then go back down to the sixteenth.
source: Passe d'abord au dix-septième étage, puis redescends au seizième.
